decisions.rationale: Names a single disease concept (breast cancer with a familial qualifier) rather than a family of multiple diseases, so it is a Specific Disease kept at its minimum span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 Specific Disease; What to Annotate 5 Minimum necessary span

decisions.rationale: Breast cancer modifies the noun families in 'breast cancer families', so it functions as a modifier of another concept.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: The contiguous string 'breast / ovarian cancer' refers to two separate diseases (breast cancer and ovarian cancer), so it is one composite mention even though it precedes a locus noun.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 2 Contiguous text strings (Composite Mention)

decisions.rationale: Breast cancer modifies the noun families in 'Dutch breast cancer families', functioning as a modifier for another noun phrase.

decisions.rationale: Ovarian cancer is named as a disease a patient can have ('at least one case of ovarian cancer'), a single specific disease mention.
'breast and / or ovarian cancer' is a contiguous string referring to two separate diseases, annotated as one composite mention.
